name: Breadcrumb
blurb: The trail of pages above the one you are on.
mechanism: An ordered list of links. Separators are `::after` on each item, so they are never read out and never end up in a copied selection. The current page is a plain `<span>` with `aria-current="page"` - a link to where you already are is a dead end.
caveats: Wrap it in `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumb">`, or it announces as an unnamed list among however many other lists the page has.
Truncating the middle with an ellipsis hides structure. If the trail is long enough to need that, the hierarchy is probably too deep.
